author: Coding agent (authoring pass)
why: REQ-21: operations enter -5 in the promo field to mean no promotion. applyDiscount() threw a RangeError on it, so checkout showed an error page and Order Import rejected the row.
before: A 200-cent cart at -5% throws RangeError. Checkout fails.
after: A 200-cent cart at -5% totals 200 cents. A bad promo percent no longer fails checkout.
preserve: Percents from 0 to 100 give the same totals as before.
approach: In applyDiscount(), replace the range check that threw with a floor at 0, so a negative percent means no discount. Whole-cent integer maths unchanged.
alternatives: Validate the promo field in the admin screen instead. Rejected: Order Import files come from partners and would still fail.
rollback: Revert the PR commit. No data migration.
